'''Gungan Ambassador''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] position that was first occupied by [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. In a context of reconciliation between two societies that had long shunned each other, that [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] was tasked with representing their [[Gungan/Legends|people]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Nabooan]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="FF 54">{{FactFile|54|JAR 9-10|Jar Jar Binks}}</ref>
